request log: seller_preemption, effective at T = now + N; judged against agreement.settlement.interruption
decision: physical end = T; scheduled end keyed by decision
notice window; vouch and renew continue to min(now + reserve_ahead, fundedThrough, T)
journal: reverse pending = the started period (seller-caused) + any excess
